reader.requirement: At --std 85 every report-name written in an FD's REPORT IS / REPORTS ARE clause must be refused unless an RD in the Report Section of the same program has that name (a data-name, a report group name, an RD of another program, or a missing Report Section are refused); the order of the names is not significant.

reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one undefined name in a two-name clause; not exercised: the name of a WORKING-STORAGE item or of a report group, no Report Section, an RD in a contained program, reversed order.
